features.title: Theme Engine Auto-Persistence & Loading
features.description: Theme selections now persist across sessions and automatically load on page refresh, providing seamless theme continuity
features.details:
Fixed critical theme persistence issue:

Previously, explicit theme parameters in init() calls were overriding stored themes, causing users to lose their theme selection on page reload.

How it works now:

  • Auto-save — Theme changes are automatically saved to localStorage when using theme.set()
  • Auto-load — On page load, the theme engine checks localStorage first before using defaults
  • Proper initialization — theme.init({ persist: true }) now correctly loads stored themes instead of forcing a default

Impact: Users' theme preferences are now respected across all pages and sessions, creating a consistent experience throughout the application.

features.title: Router External Template Loading (templateUrl)
features.description: Added support for loading view templates from external HTML files, dramatically improving code organisation and maintainability for SPA applications
features.details:
Views can now load HTML templates from separate files:

Instead of embedding large HTML strings in JavaScript, use templateUrl to reference external .html files. This provides proper syntax highlighting, cleaner code organisation, and better separation of concerns.

Key features:

  • Template caching — Templates are fetched once and cached for the session, improving performance on repeat navigation
  • Parallel partial loading — Reusable template sections (partials) are loaded concurrently with the main template
  • Mustache syntax support — Use {{variable}}, {{#if}}, {{#each}}, and {{> partial}} in external templates
  • Organised file structure — Recommended layout with js/views/templates/ directories

Benefits: Views with 400+ lines of inline HTML reduced to ~50 lines of clean JavaScript. HTML files get proper editor support, and logic stays separate from presentation.

features.title: Kickstart Template Augmented Development
features.description: Enhanced the SPA kickstart template with built-in convention enforcement for AI-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.)
features.details:
New projects now include:

  • CLAUDE.md — Consumer-focused convention enforcement with quick reference tables for Domma APIs
  • Memory file — Persistent reminders of core patterns and common mistakes
  • Updated settings — templateUrl patterns and reminders built into the project configuration

Developers using AI assistants get immediate guidance on Domma conventions, preventing common mistakes like using fetch() instead of H.get() or localStorage instead of S.set().

enhancements.title: Complete Theme System Overhaul
enhancements.description: Migrated entire component library from hardcoded palette variables to semantic theme variables, achieving full theme-readiness across all 16 themes
enhancements.details:
Massive architectural improvement to theming system:

Semantic Variable Migration:

  • Replaced ~298 instances of palette variables (--dm-gray-*, --dm-slate-*) with semantic variables
  • Components now use --dm-text, --dm-surface, --dm-border, --dm-hover-bg, etc.
  • Semantic variables automatically adapt to each theme's color scheme

Unified Dark Mode Detection:

  • Introduced data-mode attribute set by theme engine on body/html element
  • Replaced inconsistent selectors ([data-theme="dark"], [class*="-dark"]) with unified [data-mode="dark"]
  • Fixed 78+ instances across elements.css for consistent dark mode styling

Theme File Corrections:

  • Fixed ocean-light/ocean-dark file content swap (files had inverted backgrounds)
  • Fixed forest-light/forest-dark file content swap
  • Improved contrast in 5 dark themes (charcoal, silver, lemon, christmas, sunset)
  • Converted opaque status colors to RGBA tints for better dark theme integration

Impact: All components now work perfectly across all 16 themes with proper contrast and readability. Text is no longer invisible in light or dark modes.

enhancements.title: Enhanced Navbar & Footer Hover States
enhancements.description: Redesigned hover interactions for navigation and footer links with improved visibility and rounded corners
enhancements.details:
Light mode improvements:

  • Dark hover backgrounds — Navbar and dropdown links now use #1e293b (dark slate) background on hover
  • White text on hover — Ensures perfect readability with high contrast
  • Rounded corners — Changed from --dm-radius-sm to --dm-radius-md for more polished appearance
  • Footer links — Applied same dark hover treatment for consistency

Visual borders:

  • Added 1px dark bottom border to navbar in light mode (rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2))
  • Added 1px light top border to footer in dark mode (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1))
  • Provides clear visual separation without being obtrusive

Impact: Navigation elements now have consistent, highly visible hover states across all themes with professional styling.

enhancements.title: Card Header Dark Mode Contrast
enhancements.description: Improved card header readability in dark themes by darkening background instead of lightening text
enhancements.details:
Better contrast approach:

Instead of forcing white text on potentially light backgrounds, card headers now use darker backgrounds (--dm-background-alt) in dark mode.

This creates proper visual hierarchy while maintaining theme consistency. The --dm-text variable automatically provides appropriate text color for each mode.

enhancements.title: Router Showcase Comprehensive Tutorial
enhancements.description: Added extensive Template Files tutorial section to router showcase with 6 sub-sections covering all aspects of external template usage
enhancements.details:
New tutorial sections cover:

  • Problem/solution comparison (before/after examples)
  • Basic templateUrl usage with clear examples
  • Template variables and Mustache syntax
  • Partials for reusable template sections
  • Template caching behaviour and performance
  • Recommended file organisation patterns

The router is now discoverable from the showcase hub, and best practices have been updated to explicitly recommend templateUrl for views with more than a few lines of HTML.

enhancements.title: Enhanced Detail Formatting
enhancements.description: Improved release notes formatting with proper HTML structure for better readability
enhancements.details:
Release note details now use structured HTML with paragraphs, lists, and inline code formatting instead of plain text arrays.

This provides better visual hierarchy and makes complex feature descriptions easier to scan and understand.

bugFixes.title: Fixed Theme Persistence Override
bugFixes.description: Removed explicit theme parameter from landing page initialization that was preventing stored theme from loading
bugFixes.details:
Problem: theme.init({ theme: 'silver-light' }) was forcing a specific theme on every page load, ignoring localStorage.

Solution: Changed to theme.init({ persist: true }) which respects the theme storage priority: explicit param → stored theme → default theme.

Result: Theme selections now persist correctly across page refreshes and navigation.

bugFixes.title: Fixed Ocean & Forest Theme File Content Swap
bugFixes.description: Corrected inverted CSS custom property values in ocean and forest theme pairs
bugFixes.details:
Issue: Dark theme files contained light backgrounds (#ffffff) and light theme files contained dark backgrounds (#0f172a).

Fix: Swapped CSS custom property values between -light and -dark files while preserving class names and color-scheme declarations.

Impact: Ocean and forest themes now display with correct light/dark mode colors.

bugFixes.title: Fixed Splash Hero Theme Readiness
bugFixes.description: Converted splash hero from forced dark theme to fully theme-adaptive using semantic variables
bugFixes.details:
Replaced hardcoded colors with semantic variables:

  • background: #1e293b → var(--dm-background)
  • color: #ffffff → var(--dm-text)
  • Feature cards, icons, CTAs all converted to semantic variables

Splash hero now adapts perfectly to all 16 themes instead of being locked to dark mode.

bugFixes.title: Fixed Login Page Tab Visibility
bugFixes.description: Corrected login/register tab button text color in dark themes
bugFixes.details: Changed active tab from var(--dm-text-inverse) to explicit #ffffff to ensure white text on primary-colored background across all themes.

bugFixes.title: Fixed Navbar Branding Visibility
bugFixes.description: Corrected misuse of --dm-text-inverse variable that caused invisible branding in light mode
bugFixes.details:
Issue: --dm-text-inverse was being used for navbar branding, but this variable is for colored button surfaces, not theme-adaptive text.

Fix: Changed to var(--dm-text) which automatically provides dark text in light mode and light text in dark mode.

bugFixes.title: Improved Dark Theme Contrast Ratios
bugFixes.description: Fixed illegible text in 5 dark themes by adjusting primary colors and status text values
bugFixes.details:
Contrast fixes against --dm-background: #0f172a:

  • charcoal-dark: --dm-primary from #36454f → #8a9bab
  • silver-dark: --dm-tab-active-text from #4a5568 → #a0aec0
  • lemon-dark: --dm-warning-text from #8a6b20 → #d4c070
  • christmas-dark: --dm-secondary from #165b33 → #3cb371

Also converted all opaque pastel status backgrounds to RGBA tints for better dark theme integration.

bugFixes.title: Fixed Cookie Consent Component Theming
bugFixes.description: Replaced hardcoded colors with semantic variables in cookie consent component
bugFixes.details:
Converted ~20 hardcoded color values to semantic variables:

  • background: white → var(--dm-surface)
  • color: #333 → var(--dm-text)
  • border: 1px solid #e5e5e5 → var(--dm-border)

Cookie consent now respects all theme variants.

bugFixes.title: Effects Motion Preference Override
bugFixes.description: Fixed critical issue where reveal() and ripple() effects were being disabled by CSS media queries even when JavaScript explicitly set respectMotionPreference: false
bugFixes.details:
Root cause: CSS @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) queries were applying globally, overriding JavaScript configuration.

Solution:

  • Added data-force-animation attribute to elements when motion preference should be ignored
  • Updated CSS media queries to exclude elements with this attribute
  • Fixed ripple effect to apply the attribute to dynamically created ripple elements

Impact: Showcase demo pages now work correctly regardless of user's system motion preferences, ensuring animations display when explicitly configured.

bugFixes.title: Showcase Effects Pages Cleanup
bugFixes.description: Cleaned up effects showcase pages by removing references to obsolete overrideMotionPreference variable
bugFixes.details:
Updated all showcase pages to use respectMotionPreference: false consistently.

Fixed 14 remaining references across 3 showcase files, ensuring consistent behaviour and removing deprecated API usage.
